# Bloomberg

> > Bloomberg delivers business and markets digital content, data, news, and analytics through the Bloomberg Professional services platform.

Bloomberg is a global financial information and news provider, offering the Bloomberg Professional services platform (Bloomberg Terminal) for market data, analytics, trading tools, and business intelligence. The platform serves finance professionals, traders, and institutions worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Bloomberg Professional
- Bloomberg Terminal
- Bloomberg SID
- Account Management
- Billing and Invoices
- Financial Data Services
- Market Analytics
- Professional Services Platform
- Payment Portal
- Subscription Management

## Account & Billing Management

- [Account Billing](https://service.bloomberg.com/portal/bobis/index): Bloomberg Professional billing portal for invoices and account management
